racialSpecialty.name: Angelic Host (Irdon)
racialSpecialty.description: Irdon host an angelic spirit controlled by the narrator. An Irdon's spirit generates a resource referred to as their Angel Index. An Irdon may consume a point from their index to add an additional target to a non-AoE ability. Doing so will double the cost of that ability. The Angel index will be restored following a long rest.
